correctness.rationale: Reconstructed 40 exact listed Lutz tetrahedra; f=(11,51,80,40), 51 graph edges. Binary chain ranks give dim Z1=41, rank B1=40, H1(F2)=F2; explicit listed 17-edge cocycle vanishes on each of 80 face boundaries and is not a vertex coboundary. All 55 nonfacial graph triangles pair to 1. Independently used fundamental-cycle parity on each induced graph for all 2^11=2048 subsets, confirming image nonzero iff the subset contains one of the 55 generator triangles. Support counts (55,242,442,462,330,165,55,11,1) in sizes 3..11, independence polynomial 1+11t+55t²+110t³+88t⁴+20t⁵, 20 exceptional 5-sets and all 462 6-sets support. Frozen verifier additionally checks 48-element automorphism group closure and orbits 3,4,12,12,24 / 8,12; no generalization beyond exact complex.

evidence: Tightness and σ-vector theory aggregate induced Betti numbers and give injectivity criteria, not the specific image-to-global-H1 support of all 2048 subsets.

value.rationale: For the canonical minimal eleven-vertex RP3 triangulation and its unique nontrivial mod-two H1 class, the least induced support size and full hypergraph of minimal witnesses are natural local-to-global invariants. The sharp fact every six-vertex induced complex maps nontrivially, versus precisely 20 exceptional five-vertex sets, together with the symmetry orbit decomposition, is an independently reusable exact finite classification.

limitations: Finite exact labelled RP3_11; no claim for other triangulations, coefficient fields or arbitrary vertex dimensions.
